releaseNotes: Promoted Categories & Subcategories to a dedicated full screen in the Left Navigation Drawer (plus shortcut from Settings) with full-width expandable cards, multi-row FlowRow subcategory chips (never clipped), Search, Select bulk-delete, and + Category / + Sub actions.
Replaced stacked category popup dialogs with a single-layer CategoryEditorBottomSheet supporting Create, Rename, Icon/Accent Color customization, Parent Category filter, and Delete.
Fixed Material 3 dark theme container slots in Theme.kt (Flow Dark emerald-slate and Premium Black pure OLED) so dialogs, bottom sheets, and chips never render off-brand purplish-grey.
